_meta.description: Explicit, cited monthly PM2.5 overrides applied by scripts/calibrate_air.py AFTER the CAMS-shape x WHO-annual scaling, for documented burning-season / basin-smog cases that the scaling misses. Each entry: city (repo slug), months (1-12), value (µg/m³, replaces) or multiplier, reason, source (URL), sourceLicence where known. Only add an entry when a ground-measured monthly figure can be cited.

unresolved.sofia: CAMS seasonal shape is flat (winter 12 vs summer 9 µg/m³) although Sofia has well-documented heating-season smog; no citable monthly PM2.5 series found yet (ExEA / EEA monthly statistics would qualify).
unresolved.plovdiv: Same pattern as Sofia (flat CAMS shape); no citable monthly series found.

overrides.reason: Burning season. Mean of PCD monthly averages at station 35T (Chiang Mai City Hall) for 2020-2023: Feb 56/47/30/51, Mar 91/78/43/88, Apr 65/38/41/105 µg/m³. CAMS (~45 km) smooths the smoke peak (scaled CAMS gave Feb 38, Mar 50, Apr 50).
overrides.sourceDetail: Chayathawat W. (2024), Forecasting Monthly Average PM2.5 in Chiang Mai Province Using Classical Decomposition Method, Science and Technology for Community Journal, Table 1 (data: Air Quality and Noise Management Division, Pollution Control Department, 2023).
overrides.sourceLicence: journal article; factual figures cited with attribution

overrides.reason: Basin heating smog. Mean of 2023 and 2024 monthly PM2.5 at the Lisice station (Ministry of Environment monitoring network, BAM). CAMS shape is far too flat (scaled winter ~32 µg/m³ vs measured 58-97). Same years as the CAMS window, so all 12 months are replaced. Single station in the more polluted east of the city: likely biased high vs the city-wide mean.
overrides.sourceDetail: Ceka R., Cuci O., Demaj I., Zenku A., Spahiju F. (2026), Monitoring of PM10 and PM2.5 Air Quality in Skopje, North Macedonia (2023-2024), IJDNE 21(5), Table 2.
overrides.sourceLicence: journal article; factual figures cited with attribution

overrides.reason: Basin heating smog with inversions. Monthly means of hourly US EPA MetOne BAM-1020 PM2.5 in Sarajevo, May 2018-Aug 2019 (Jun/Jul/Aug averaged over both years; Jan/Feb 2019 have 45%/64% hourly coverage). CAMS shape is inverted here (scaled CAMS peaked in summer at 33 µg/m³ and gave Dec 26). One winter only (2018-19) and older than the WHO 2022-24 annual (28.4): treat winter magnitudes as indicative.
overrides.sourceDetail: U.S. EPA Office of Research and Development (2019), Sarajevo PM2.5 Data from MetOne BAM-1020, https://pasteur.epa.gov/uploads/10.23719/1518365/Sarajevo-confproc-data.csv
